import sys
import pytest
from colorama.ansitowin32 import AnsiToWin32

def test_ansitowin32_windows_console_handle():
    if sys.platform != 'win32':
        pytest.skip('Requires Windows OS kernel32 console APIs')
    a = AnsiToWin32(sys.stdout)
    assert a.has_reduced_output()

test_code:
import pytest
from semver import Version

def test_replace_preserves_constructor_type_error():
    v = Version.parse('1.2.3')
    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as excinfo:
        v.replace(major=None)
    assert '0 unexpected keyword' not in str(excinfo.value)
title: Preserve constructor TypeError in Version.replace
